describes: packages/plugin/annotation: markup, caret and replace-text from the selection plugin’s signals, and markupFromSelection.

cases.name: highlight-by-drag
cases.covers: Under the highlight tool the selection gesture drives a live markup preview (the blue highlight suppressed); the commit creates one highlight per selected page from the per-line quads, with the tool’s defaults, and clears the selection.

cases.name: insert-and-replace-text
cases.covers: The insert-text tool creates a caret at the selection’s end anchor; the replace-text tool previews as a strikeout and creates one Caret + StrikeOut group per page (the true end anchor on the end page).

cases.name: replace-text-across-pages
cases.covers: A selection spanning two pages under replace-text anchors each non-end page at its last segment’s trailing edge.

cases.name: preview-follows-the-tool
cases.covers: A selection made under the pointer tool keeps the blue highlight; switching to a markup tool previews it as that markup, back to the pointer tool clears the preview and restores the highlight. Without a selection the preview clears.

cases.name: markup-from-selection
cases.covers: markupFromSelection turns the current selection into one markup per page with segments (the preset’s flags ride along), clears it, and returns true; with nothing selected it returns false.

cases.name: markup-needs-a-selection-plugin-and-authority
cases.covers: Without a selection plugin markupFromSelection is false and the markup tools never register; without create authority it is false and createMarkup, createCaret and createReplaceText do nothing.
